dishes.name: Pimientos de Padrón
dishes.description: Petits poivrons verts frits à l'huile d'olive.
dishes.description_en: Small green peppers fried in olive oil.

dishes.name: Barbajuan sauce tomate
dishes.description: Raviolis frits farcis à la blette et fromage.
dishes.description_en: Barbajuan with tomato sauce: fried ravioli stuffed with Swiss chard and cheese.

dishes.name: Ktipiti
dishes.description: Crème de poivrons grillés, fromage fêta, yaourt, huile d'olive, menthe fraîche et pain comme une pita.
dishes.description_en: Cream of grilled peppers mixed with feta cheese, yogurt, olive oil, mint and bread like a pita.

dishes.name: Stracciatella crémeuse
dishes.description: Le cœur de mozzarella crémeuse, tomates colorées, basilic frais et charbon végétal.
dishes.description_en: Creamy mozzarella heart stracciatella, colorful tomatoes, fresh basil and vegetal coal.

dishes.name: Poêlée de coquillages
dishes.description: Palourdes et moules au vin blanc, persillade.
dishes.description_en: Pan-fried shellfish: clams and mussels in white wine sauce, garlic parsley oil.

dishes.name: Ceviche Paloma
dishes.description: Daurade marinée aux agrumes et pickles de légumes.
dishes.description_en: Sea-bream ceviche, vegetables pickles and citrus marinade.

dishes.name: La Baia
dishes.description: Pastèque, fromage fêta, tomate, melon, roquette, trait de balsamique, menthe fraîche.
dishes.description_en: Watermelon, feta cheese, tomato, melon, arugula, balsamic and fresh mint.

dishes.name: La traditionnelle d'artichaut
dishes.description: Artichauts frais coupés finement, roquette, copeaux de parmesan, sauce ancholade légère.
dishes.description_en: Finely chopped fresh artichokes, arugula, parmesan shavings, light anchovy sauce.

dishes.name: L'autre caesar
dishes.description: Crevettes marinées, salade romaine, sauce caesar, noisettes torréfiées, copeaux de parmesan, tomates cerises, petits croûtons.
dishes.description_en: Marinaded shrimps, romaine salad, caesar sauce, roasted hazelnuts, parmesan shavings, cherry tomatoes, croutons.

dishes.name: La pause vegan
dishes.description: Jeunes pousses d'épinard, avocat, pois chiches, betteraves crues, mélange de graines, houmous, grenade, sauce soja cacahuète.
dishes.description_en: Baby spinach, avocado, chickpeas, raw beets, mixed seeds, hummus, pomegranate, peanut soy sauce.

dishes.name: Salade crottin de Chavignol & copeaux de truffes d'été
dishes.description: Tuber aestivum, asperges vertes, artichauts crus, roquette, ancholade légère.
dishes.description_en: Chavignol goat cheese salad, green asparagus, artichokes, arugula, light anchovy sauce, « Tuber aestivum » truffle shavings.

dishes.name: Authentique Margarita
dishes.description: Sauce tomate, mozzarella di Bufala, feuilles de basilic frais.
dishes.description_en: Tomato sauce, Bufala mozzarella and basil leaves.

dishes.name: Gamberoni
dishes.description: Sauce tomate, mozzarella di Bufala, crevettes, persillade.
dishes.description_en: Tomato sauce, Bufala mozzarella, shrimps, garlic parsley oil.

dishes.name: Picante
dishes.description: Sauce tomate, mozzarella, cantal, salami piquant, oignons rouges crus, poivrons rouges grillés.
dishes.description_en: Tomato sauce, mozzarella, cantal, spicy salami, raw red onions, grilled red peppers.

dishes.name: Fresca
dishes.description: Pâte blanche garnie à la sortie du four de tomates fraîches de couleur, jambon cru et mozzarella stracciatella.
dishes.description_en: White pizza topped out of the oven with fresh colored tomatoes, prosciutto and mozzarella stracciatella.

dishes.name: Berlugane love
dishes.description: Pâte blanche, mozzarella, cantal, aubergines confites, artichauts frais, garnie à la sortie du four de noisettes torréfiées, ricotta et basilic frais.
dishes.description_en: White pizza, mozzarella, cantal, eggplant confit, fresh artichokes, garnished out of the oven with roasted hazelnuts, ricotta and fresh basil.

dishes.name: Tartufa
dishes.description: Pâte blanche, mozzarella, cantal, garnie à la sortie du four de salade roquette et lamelles de truffe d'été Tuber Aestivum.
dishes.description_en: White pizza, mozzarella, cantal, garnished straight of the oven with arugula and slices of Tuber Aestivum summer truffle.

dishes.name: Gnocchi frais alla Sorrentina
dishes.description: Gnocchi, sauce tomate maison, cœur de stracciatella onctueuse.
dishes.description_en: Gnocchi, homemade tomato sauce, creamy stracciatella heart.

dishes.name: Rigatoni frais à la truffe
dishes.description: Rigatoni à la crème de truffe et copeaux de truffes d'été Tuber Aestivum.
dishes.description_en: Rigatoni with truffle cream and Tuber Aestivum summer truffle shavings.

dishes.name: Linguini aux coquillages
dishes.description: Linguini aux palourdes et aux moules, persillade et neige de poutargue.
dishes.description_en: Linguini with clams and mussels, garlic parsley oil and bottarga fish row sprinkle.

dishes.name: Pâtes à la langouste
dishes.description: Pâtes à la crème, bisque de langouste et queue de langouste.
dishes.description_en: Pasta with lobster bisque & lobster tail.

dishes.name: Daurade aux deux pesto façon Baia Bella
dishes.description: Cuite au charbon de bois, ouverte en portefeuille avec duo de pesto rouge et de pesto vert, légumes grillés et salade d'herbes folles.
dishes.description_en: Whole sea bream grilled over the wood fire, opened and prepared with two types of pesto, served with grilled vegetables and fresh herbs salad.

dishes.name: Loup grillé entier cuit au charbon de bois
dishes.description: Pour deux personnes, pomme de terre en robe des champs et légumes grillés.
dishes.description_en: Grilled whole sea bass over the wood fire for two, served with jacket potato and grilled vegetables.

dishes.name: Scampis sauvages rôtis
dishes.description: Cuits au four, pomme de terre en robe des champs et légumes grillés.
dishes.description_en: Scampies cooked in the oven and served with jacket potato and grilled vegetables.

dishes.name: Filet de rascasse
dishes.description: Cuit à la plancha, purée de petits pois froide, salade d'herbes folles et huile au paprika fumé.
dishes.description_en: Seared red scorpionfish fillet, chilled green peas purée, wild herb salad and smoked paprika oil.

dishes.name: Loup · Sea bass
dishes.description: Pêche selon arrivage, vendu au poids.
dishes.description_en: Fish for more than 2 people are sold by weight — price by weight, per 100 g.

dishes.description: Pêche selon arrivage, vendu au poids.
dishes.description_en: Fish for more than 2 people are sold by weight — price by weight, per 100 g.

dishes.name: Tartare de bœuf traditionnel
dishes.description: Pommes de terre et salade.
dishes.description_en: Raw beef tartare with potatoes and salad.

dishes.name: Filet de bœuf à la braise
dishes.description: Origine France, jus court au romarin, légumes grillés et panisses artisanales.
dishes.description_en: Grilled beef sirloin over a wood fire (250 g approx), France, rosemary juice, served with grilled vegetables and panisses: local chickpea fries.

dishes.name: Demi-coquelet à la braise
dishes.description: Marinade au chimichurri rouge, pomme de terre en robe des champs, légumes grillés.
dishes.description_en: Grilled chicken cooked over the wood fire, marinade with red chimichurri, jacket potato, grilled vegetables.

dishes.name: Tomahawk de bœuf
dishes.description: Environ 1,3 kg, pour 2 ou 3 personnes, cuit à la braise. Pomme de terre en robe des champs et légumes grillés.
dishes.description_en: Beef Tomahawk cooked over the wood fire, served with jacket potato and grilled vegetables. For 2 or 3 people.

dishes.name: Menu enfant
dishes.description: Steak haché, frites et légumes — ou — Mini pizza marguerite sauce tomate, mozzarella, cantal — et — une boule de glace au choix pour les plus sages.
dishes.description_en: Burger patty, fries and vegetables — or — Mini margarita pizza, tomato sauce, mozzarella, cantal — and — a scoop of ice cream of your choice.
